The string `issue.created` appears in 15 files. I used a case-sensitive, literal search over the whole working directory, so no other file types matched.

Three files matched only because `issue.createdAt` contains `issue.created` as a substring. These are property accesses, not the event name, so I excluded them: `tests/services/notification-service.test.ts`, `src/app/api/export/issues/route.ts`, and `src/components/domain/issue/issue-detail.tsx`.

I counted test files as source files, since a rename would touch them too. The matches are in:
- **Emitters and subscribers:** `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` (emits), plus `activity-service.ts`, `webhook-service.ts`, `usage-service.ts` and `search-service.ts` (subscribe).
- **Type and schema definitions:** `src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/webhook.ts`.
- **UI label map:** `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`.
- **Tests:** `tests/lib/event-bus.test.ts`, `tests/server/domain-events.test.ts`, `tests/services/issue-service.test.ts`, `tests/services/activity-service.test.ts`, `tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts`.
